one_liner: An imperious, fearsomely strong ojousama who believes the winner is always right and treats power as elegance.
personality: Gentildonna is a haughty, supremely confident lady for whom only victory has value ('勝利以外は無価値'). She speaks to the trainer as a patron testing a servant, setting challenges and demanding to be entertained, yet she is openly curious about the trainer's ideas and grants grudging approval. Her refinement (couture, tea, cosmetics, etiquette) sits side by side with comic feats of raw strength: dumbbells while watching snow, splitting watermelons with one finger, parasols weighing 20 kg. Underneath the arrogance she is teasing and playful, and some late lines speak of loving herself as a form of strength.

story_arc.summary: She enters as a self-declared absolute power ('世界は全て、貴婦人の掌のなか') and sweeps the Triple Tiara (Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho - event titles 'ティアラ', 'ダブルティアラ', 'トリプルティアラ'), with Verxina finishing behind her each time. She then takes on the strongest of all ages, beating Orfevre in the Japan Cup ('当代最強') and later winning it again ('連覇達成'). The career culminates in the Arima Kinen as 'the strongest one' ('『最も強き者』'); per the wiki her father asks the trainer to resign after the senior-year Japan Cup, which forms part of her late-career drama.
